versions.changelog:
Version 1.2.5

- No changes detected in this release.

Initial release of cn-qrcode-reader:

- Supports QR code and barcode (EAN-13, Code-128, etc.) recognition from images.
- Accepts image files via camera or file input; supports glob patterns for batch processing.
- Detects multiple formats: URLs, text, contact info, and more.
- Command-line options for verbose output and saving results to a file.
- Requires Python 3.x, Pillow, pyzbar, and zbar library.
